data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for the native Usabilla SDK to collect user feedback and run campaigns.
data.what_it_does: It provides a bridge to the native Android and iOS Usabilla SDKs, enabling apps to load passive feedback forms, trigger proactive marketing and survey campaigns based on events, and collect user insights.
use_when: You need to integrate Usabilla feedback forms or surveys into a Flutter application.
You want to target users with campaigns based on events without releasing new app versions.
avoid_when: You need a generic custom survey framework built entirely in Flutter without a third-party backend.
Your project does not use Usabilla or GetFeedback Digital.
strengths: Direct wrapper for official native Usabilla SDKs.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Allows management of campaigns via web interface without app updates.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the proprietary Usabilla/GetFeedback ecosystem.
Requires platform-specific configuration on both Android and iOS.
High Flutter version requirements (v2.6.0+ requires Flutter >=3.27.0, v2.7.0 requires >=3.44.0).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and photo library permissions on iOS, setting up Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods, and extending FlutterFragmentActivity and updating compile/min SDK versions on Android.
